name: Registered Contract 19
definition: Document that a user must file with an authorised servicer for each contract that involves foreign currency transactions with non residents.

RegisteredContractClosureIdentification.name: Registered Contract Closure Identification
RegisteredContractClosureIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the registered contract closure.

ReportingParty.name: Reporting Party
ReportingParty.definition: Party who registered the currency control contract.

RegistrationAgent.name: Registration Agent
RegistrationAgent.definition: Agent who registered the currency control contract.

Priority.name: Priority
Priority.definition: Priority of the registered contract closure.

Attachment.name: Attachment
Attachment.definition: Documents provided as attachments to the contract registration closure request.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
